title: Poulet à la Pizza (Chicken Pizza)

ingredients.title: Pizza Dough (Classic Neapolitan Style)
items: 500 g “00” flour (Italian finely milled pizza flour)
2 g fresh yeast (or 1 g active dry yeast)

ingredients.title: Cheese & Garnish
items: 150 g fresh mozzarella di bufala, torn into pieces
Drizzle of extra virgin olive oil

instruction.title: Step 1 – Dough Preparation (24 hrs ahead)
steps: Dissolve yeast in cold water.
Gradually add flour, mixing gently until combined.
Add salt last, knead until smooth (10 mins by hand, 5 mins with mixer).
Rest covered at room temperature for 1 hr.
Transfer to airtight container, refrigerate 20–24 hrs (cold fermentation for flavor & texture).
Remove 2 hrs before baking, divide into 2 x 250 g balls, rest covered.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Sauce
steps: Hand-crush San Marzano tomatoes.
Mix with olive oil, basil, and a pinch of salt.
Keep raw (traditional Neapolitan style).

instruction.title: Step 3 – Chicken
steps: Heat olive oil in pan, add garlic, then sliced chicken.
Season with oregano, chili flakes, salt & pepper.
Sear quickly until just cooked (avoid drying).
Set aside to cool slightly.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Assembly
steps: Preheat oven with pizza stone to 480–500°C (900–930°F) if wood-fired, or as hot as possible (at least 250°C / 480°F) in a home oven.
Stretch dough ball into a 10–12 inch round.
Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce.
Add torn mozzarella evenly.
Arrange seared chicken slices.
Sprinkle Parmigiano-Reggiano.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Baking
steps: Bake in wood-fired oven: 60–90 seconds (rotate halfway).
Bake in home oven with stone/steel: 6–8 minutes until crust is blistered and cheese melted.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Finishing Touch
steps: Garnish with fresh basil leaves.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil.
Serve immediately.

chefTips: For extra depth, marinate chicken with a splash of white wine & rosemary before searing.
Use smoked mozzarella (scamorza affumicata) for a gourmet variation.
A drizzle of chili oil at service adds a professional touch.
